The Opportunity Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day. As a GenAI Full Stack Senior Associate you will support the design and development of full stack GenAI solutions, turning business needs into practical data and technology deliverables within our Data & Analytics Engineering practice. As a Senior Associate you will analyze complex problems, manage assigned workstreams, build client relationships, and guide junior team members while navigating changing priorities and using critical thinking to shape solution delivery. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will apply data science methods, use modern development tools and techniques, interpret data for insights, and contribute to AI-driven automation and cognitive solutions that support client needs. Responsibilities Design and develop responsive, performant user interfaces using modern frontend frameworks (React, Angular, Vue.js), implementing reusable component libraries and ensuring design consistency. Optimize frontend performance through techniques like lazy loading, code splitting, caching, and efficient rendering strategies for scalable web applications. Build, secure, and maintain scalable REST and GraphQL APIs and backend services using Node.js, Java Spring Boot, or Python, handling business logic, data validation, and error handling. Develop and manage microservices architectures and design relational and NoSQL database schemas with optimized queries and migrations for production environments. Deploy applications on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) leveraging Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins) for continuous integration and delivery. Collaborate closely with product managers to translate UX designs and user stories into pixel-perfect, accessible, and consistent user interfaces across devices and browsers. What You Must Have Bachelor's & Master's Degree 4 years of experience Oral and written proficiency in English required What Sets You Apart Experience working with AI or Generative AI tools-based applications. Strong backend development skills using Node.js, Nest.js, Java Spring Boot, or Python frameworks, with solid understanding of RESTful APIs and GraphQL. Proficient in front-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks like React, Vue.js, or Next.js. Familiarity with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB, along with authentication and authorization mechanisms. Knowledgeable in version control systems, preferably Git, to manage code and collaborate effectively. Base pay range ₹1,700,000.00/yr - ₹2,600,000.00/yr Job Description We are looking for a Full Stack Developer with strong expertise in Microsoft. NET technologies (C#, ASP. NET Core, and Web API) and Angular (latest versions) and React (latest versions) to design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise applications. The role involves end-to-end ownership of backend APIs, frontend UI development, and collaboration with cross-functional teams, including QA, DevOps, and Product. The core responsibilities for the job include the following: Backend (. NET/C#): - Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs using ASP. NET Core / Web API. - Implement business logic using C#, following clean code and SOLID principles. - Work with SQL Server / PostgreSQL for data modeling, queries, and performance optimization. - Integrate with third-party systems and internal services. - Ensure application security, logging, exception handling, and performance tuning. - Participate in code reviews and enforce backend best practices. Frontend (Angular): - Develop responsive and scalable UI applications using Angular (v8+). - Build reusable components using TypeScript, HTML5 CSS3 SCSS. - Implement reactive Forms, state management, and API integrations. - Ensure cross-browser compatibility and performance optimization. - Collaborate with UX/UI designers to translate designs into high-quality code. DevOps and Collaboration: - Work with Git/Azure DevOps/CI-CD pipelines for build and deployment. - Collaborate with QA teams to support automation and defect resolution. - Participate in sprint planning, estimations, and agile ceremonies. - Prepare technical documentation and support production deployments. Requirements: - Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field. - Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. - Experience working in enterprise or product-based environments. - Experience: 5 - 8 years. - Mandatory: C#, ASP. NET Core, Web API, Angular (8+) and React, TypeScript, HTML5 CSS3 SCSS, SQL Server/PostgreSQL, REST API design and integration, Git, and Azure DevOps/GitHub. - React experience is Added advantage. Good to Have: - Azure services (App Services, Functions, Storage, Key Vault). - Authentication and authorization (JWT, OAuth, Role-based access). - Microservices architecture. - Unit testing frameworks (xUnit, NUnit, Jasmine, Karma). - Exposure to performance monitoring and production support. Behavioral and Soft Skills: - Ownership mindset and attention to detail. - Strong communication and stakeholder collaboration. - Ability to work independently and in fast-paced agile teams. Company Summary SUN Mobility aims to be the leading provider of universal energy infrastructure and services to accelerate mass electric vehicle usage. The organization plans to revolutionize the transportation sector by deploying a unique open-architecture ecosystem built around a smart network of quick interchange battery stations. These stations, predominantly powered by renewable energy, will refuel electric vehicles at cost lower than and speed faster than conventional petrol pumps. SUN Mobility will partner with multiple OEMs to integrate SUN Mobility's proprietary smart battery solution into a range of innovative electric vehicles - cars, buses, rickshaws, scooters etc. The smart batteries will be modular, easily swappable, highly secure, IOT enabled and can be easily refuelled on a pay-as-you go basis. This energy infrastructure integrated with electric vehicles, smart batteries and clean energy will accelerate the transformation of mobility towards a sustainable, pollution-free future. Why Join Us We are going to transform urban transportation; the way people commute in the future will undergo a complete makeover. We want mobility to be fuelled by clean energy and be electric, shared, connected and clean. Come, join us to make history. Can you juggle multiple projects with your sharp sense of detail and drive to success? Are you a champion for quality and excellence and not afraid to do what it takes to get there? If you are stirred by a constant desire to usher in change in the world around you, to work for the larger good and make a lasting impact on society, then we'd love to talk. Maybe, you're the missing cog we need!
